user_story: As a user, I want to submit the contact form on the 'Contact Us' page so that I can send feedback to the company. Acceptance Criteria: 1. The form must have the following fields: 'name' (selector: 'input[name="name"]'), 'email' (selector: 'input[name="email"]'), 'subject' (selector: 'input[name="subject"]'), and 'message' (selector: 'textarea#message'). 2. Upon successful submission, the user should remain on the same page (URL: 'https://automationexercise.com/contact_us'). 3. If any required field is left empty and the user attempts to submit, the form should not submit and the user should remain on the same page (URL: 'https://automationexercise.com/contact_us').

As a user, I want to log in to the application so that I can access the features available for authenticated users. 
Acceptance Criteria:
1. The user must be able to enter a valid username in the input field identified by [data-test="username"].
2. The user must be able to enter a valid password in the input field identified by [data-test="password"].
3. Upon clicking the login button identified by [data-test="login-button"], the user should be redirected to the main application page.
4. If the user enters an invalid username or password, they should remain on the login page and see an error message (not specified in the inventory).

As a user, I want to log into the application using my credentials so that I can access the secure area. Acceptance Criteria: 
1. Given I am on the login page at 'https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/login', when I enter 'tomsmith' in the input with id 'username' and 'SuperSecretPassword!' in the input with id 'password', and click the button with text 'Login', I should be redirected to the secure area. 
2. If I enter incorrect credentials, I should remain on the login page and not be redirected. 
3. The flash messages should be displayed in the div with id 'flash-messages'.

As a user, I want to be able to check and uncheck checkboxes so that I can select my preferences. Acceptance Criteria: 
1. The page should contain two checkboxes represented by 'input' elements of type 'checkbox'. 
2. The state of the checkboxes should be toggled correctly when clicked. 
3. The page URL should remain the same after interacting with the checkboxes.

As a user, I want to add and remove elements on the 'Add/Remove Elements' page so that I can dynamically manage the number of elements displayed. Acceptance Criteria: 
1. When I click the 'Add Element' button, a new element should be added to the page. 
2. The URL should remain the same: 'https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/add_remove_elements/'. 
3. The 'Add Element' button should be visible on the page. 
4. After adding an element, I can remove it by clicking on the newly added element. 
5. The number of elements displayed should decrease by one after removing an element. 
6. The 'flash-messages' div should be present on the page.

As a user, I want to be able to interact with JavaScript alert dialogs on the page so that I can test the alert functionality. Acceptance Criteria: When I click the button with text 'Click for JS Alert', a JavaScript alert should appear. When I accept the alert, I should see a result reflected in the element with id 'result'. When I click the button with text 'Click for JS Confirm', a confirmation dialog should appear, and upon accepting it, the result should also be reflected in the element with id 'result'.
